title: plugin-gantt, app-shell designers: an invalid gantt block is warned about and drawn anyway, and a failed spec derivation degrades the designer form instead of failing — refuse loudly
body:
Filing gate ③: a maintainer-directed task. Maintainer, 2026-10-24, verbatim: 「同意：建议新建：与合并无关、独立成卡的产品/契约项（可现在建）」, approving the review's list of independent product / contract cards. Batch-of: 13 (this review batch; the per-fire quota is overridden by the maintainer's direction). Also filing gate ①: reach: a gantt view whose `gantt` config block fails `GanttConfigSchema` renders through `packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx` (named renderer); the designer forms under `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` derive their schema from the spec at runtime.

## 维护者速读

元数据路径上唯一一处「校验失败只 warn 然后照画」：`ObjectGantt.tsx` 的 `GanttConfigSchema.safeParse(config)` 失败后 `console.warn` 并返回原 config 继续渲染；对照 `ObjectTimeline.tsx` 的姿态（「日期轴永不虚构」，失败就拒绝）。另一类：设计器的 `*-schema.ts` 从 spec 派生 JSONSchema 失败时 catch → warn → 降级表单——派生失败是构建期事实，应让测试红而不是让页面降级。北极星：「验证响亮拒绝错的」。

## Measured (2026-10-24, HEAD 7981384)

- `safeParse(` sites in non-test source: 73; three follow the warn-and-continue shape; the one on the metadata render path is in `packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx`: `const result = GanttConfigSchema.safeParse(config); if (!result.success) console.warn(…); … return config`.
- Contrast `packages/plugin-timeline/src/ObjectTimeline.tsx` ("日期轴永不虚构 — `undefined` from here is a real answer, and the refusal below is what answers it").
- Metadata-shaped `console.warn` sites: 20, mostly `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/*-schema.ts` "failed to derive … JSONSchema from spec" (catch → warn → degraded designer form); also `plugin-gantt/src/tzShift.ts` (invalid `timeZone` falls back to the browser zone) and `core/src/utils/date-display.ts`.
- Repo-wide: `catch` sites 1,738; comment-only or empty catch blocks 252 (top: `auth/src/createAuthClient.ts` 9, `app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx` 8); `invariant(` 0 (no helper exists). Not all are defects; the two above are the metadata-path ones.
- Business reason: an AI-authored gantt block with a wrong key renders something plausible instead of a refusal, so the author never learns; a designer form that silently lost fields because derivation failed lets the author save metadata the spec will refuse.
- Dedup (`GanttConfigSchema|safeParse … warn`): 1 hit, closed, unrelated (objectui#12709).

## Task

- [ ] `ObjectGantt`: on `!result.success` render the refusal (the timeline's posture), never the unvalidated config.
- [ ] Designer `*-schema.ts` derivations: a failed derivation from spec fails a test (build-time fact), not the page; keep the runtime catch only for genuinely runtime inputs.
- [ ] Optional: `tzShift.ts` invalid `timeZone` — refuse or surface, do not silently use the browser zone (decide with the spec row for `timeZone`).

Who acts: objectui `domain:ui` seat, one PR for gantt, one for the designer derivations. Effort S each.

Filed by the read-only whole-repo review session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BDtwYUWhLGyWLzYQjZ95Cf` on 2026-10-24, written through the maintainer's own account token (the session holds no fleet-bot credential).
